action.description: Action(s) triggered when the rule matches (e.g. kill, scan-files).

comment.description: A description of what the Kunai rule detects (meta.comments).

decision.description: Decision applied to matching events, controlling whether they are logged.

disabled.description: Set to true if the rule is disabled (params.disable).

event-type.description: Kunai event type(s) the rule matches on (match-on.events.kunai), e.g. execve. Prefix with '-' to exclude an event type.

kunai.description: Kunai detection, filter, or dependency rule (YAML).

mitre-attack-id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID(s) associated with the rule (meta.attack).

reference.description: Reference URL for the rule source or documentation.

rule-name.description: Unique identifier of the Kunai rule (the top-level name field).

severity.description: Severity score assigned to the rule (1-10, detection rules only).

tag.description: Free-text tag associated with the rule (meta.tags).

description: An object describing a Kunai rule (detection, filter, or dependency), its event matching, severity, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, following the Kunai rule syntax (https://why.kunai.rocks/docs/next/advanced/rule_syntax_reference).
name: kunai-rule
